I am old now, 86 years, and I have farmed this land my whole life. This small maize plot near the house is where my family gets our nsima, so I must take care of it even though my back is not what it used to be. If the coupon comes this year I will take the fertilizer — last time I got one bag of 23-21-0 and one bag of urea from FISP, and the maize grew tall. Without the coupon I cannot buy fertilizer with my own money, but I am hoping, like every year. I will put the manure from my goats and chickens on the plot like I always do, and I will plant the hybrid seed if the coupon brings it, otherwise I save seed from last harvest. My sons and grandchildren help me with the work because I cannot dig like before.
